title.en: Fable 19 — The Two Travellers and the Bear

sentences.en: A bear came upon them on the road.
The first climbed the tree quickly.
The second threw himself on the ground.
The bear sniffed him and left.

sentences.ar: نزل الأول وسأل: شو قال لك؟
sentences.en: The first came down and asked: what did he say to you?

sentences.ar: قال: قال لي لا تسافر مع حدا بيتركك.
sentences.en: He said: he told me not to travel with someone who leaves you.
